page.overview:
Who is Jala Bandevin?

She is around five feet tall. Moiraine, at 5'2" (157 cm), is "nearly a hand taller".

The ending of her surname suggests a Cairhienin origin.

Due to her already having gray hair at the time of the Aiel War, she likely to have been born before .

At this time, she had two Warders, one was a round-faced man playing a stately melody on a flute, the other a pale-haired young man no more than twenty. It is unknown if those Warders are still alive by .
